what_this_release_delivers: #172 storage-neutral RequestStore seam - server/app.js routes depend on server/request-store.js rather than server/github.js directly; createGitHubRequestStore is injected at launch; server/gh.js remains the sole GitHub process boundary
#173/#175 guided three-intent request composer - prominent top-level intent selection (Share feedback, Build or change, Report a problem) above Title and the shared primary answer

#173/#175 entry defaults and direct switching - app Feedback defaults to Share feedback with #169 app context; Start a request / New request default to Build or change; switching intents preserves Title, the shared primary answer, and keyed optional fields

#173/#175 target-owned markers and preview - renders human-readable Markdown with blankcanvas.feedback@1, blankcanvas.change@1, or blankcanvas.problem@1, read-only preview, and reversible Write freely instead / Use guided form mode
#173/#175 draft schema v2 - migrates legacy {title, body} drafts into freeform mode without data loss while preserving app/home draft separation
